I replied to Hollis in his #central-team thread: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at **Gate 47**.

On Oct 14 Pree first posted Dock 23 in #central-team. Later that morning she corrected it to Gate 47, saying she'd read the wrong line. Nothing after that changes it. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so both of her messages were already visible to him.
